summary: ReTo Eco-Solutions (Buyer) terminated its April 2025 share-exchange acquisition of MeinMalzeBier Holdings for 51% equity. The deal, which closed with $3.978M cash + 4.68M Buyer Class A shares placed in escrow, was unwound via a Termination and Release Agreement on June 2, 2026. Sellers return 5,100 purchased shares, forfeit the escrowed exchange shares, and pay $300K cash. Conditions include receipt of that payment and joint escrow-agent instructions. The original acquisition (without disclosed premium) is reversed; watch for shareholder litigation or regulatory clean-up given the quick unwind.
